Remote actor implementation was not included, so its behavior remains outside this source review.

content.user_title: Compare Booking.com Hotel Prices and Amenities
content.value_statement: Comparing hotel prices and amenities across matching travel dates requires repetitive searches. This skill submits structured searches to an Apify actor and returns public Booking.com listing data.
actual_capabilities: Submit destination searches or specific public Booking.com hotel URLs to the documented Apify actor.
Configure travel dates, adult guests, rooms, currency, language, and result limits.
Request property type, star rating, review score, nightly price, cancellation, breakfast, and pool filters.
Request room tables and full amenity lists through optional actor inputs.
Return structured hotel rows with declared fields for prices, ratings, review counts, amenities, and listing URLs.
Run synchronous requests with Node 18+ or curl, with a documented asynchronous API example for larger requests.
limitations: Requires internet access, an Apify account, and APIFY_TOKEN; actor usage is billed to that account.
The package delegates scraping to a remote actor whose implementation is not included for inspection.
Prices, availability, field completeness, and successful extraction depend on Booking.com and the remote actor.
Only public data is supported; the Node runner returns JSON and does not provide scheduling or built-in CSV conversion.

use_cases.title: Compare Travel Options
use_cases.description: Collect hotel prices, guest ratings, breakfast availability, and cancellation options for a destination and matching stay dates.

use_cases.title: Review Competing Hotel Rates
use_cases.description: Gather public competitor listings with consistent dates, occupancy, and currency for a controlled rate comparison.

use_cases.title: Prepare Hospitality Research Data
use_cases.description: Request bounded listing samples with review counts and amenities for downstream analysis.

prompt_templates.title: Find Hotels
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Paris hotels for December 1 to 3, 2026, for two adults and one room. Return up to five listings in USD.

prompt_templates.title: Filter a Shortlist
prompt_templates.prompt: Find Tokyo hotels for January 10 to 13, 2027, for two adults. Require breakfast, free cancellation, and review scores above 8. Limit results to ten.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect Specific Properties
prompt_templates.prompt: Use details mode for the public Booking.com hotel URLs I provide. Include room types and full amenities for my specified dates and occupancy.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Controlled Rate Comparison
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an asynchronous Paris hotel search for December 1 to 3, 2026, with two adults, one room, EUR, and 100 results. Confirm costs before execution.

output_examples.input: Compare two Paris hotels for a two-night stay in USD.
output: Illustrative format only; these are not live search results.
Sample Hotel A: USD 300 total; USD 150 nightly; guest score 8.5; 420 reviews; breakfast included; free cancellation available.
Sample Hotel B: USD 340 total; USD 170 nightly; guest score 9.0; 610 reviews; breakfast excluded; pool listed.

output_examples.input: Summarize amenities and room information for a selected public hotel URL.
output: Illustrative format only; these are not live property details.
Sample property: Wi-Fi, pool, and restaurant listed; breakfast available; two room types returned.
The summary includes the source listing URL when returned by the actor.

best_practices: Set explicit dates, occupancy, and currency, and compare nightly prices separately from stay totals and taxes.
Start with a small maxItems value, review sample rows, and confirm current Apify pricing before expanding collection.
Use only public inputs, keep tokens out of prompts, and check site terms and applicable law before collection.
anti_patterns: Submitting cookies, sessions, private account data, or unrelated local files to the actor.
Treating extracted prices or cancellation labels as guaranteed booking terms without checking the source listing.
Assuming the skill includes free execution, automatic scheduling, or direct CSV conversion.

faq.question: What credentials are required?
faq.answer: Set APIFY_TOKEN in the environment using your Apify account token. The Node runner requires Node 18 or later.

faq.question: Can I search specific hotel URLs?
faq.answer: Yes. Use details mode and supply public Booking.com hotel URLs through startUrls.

faq.question: Which hotel details can I request?
faq.answer: Declared outputs include prices, ratings, review counts, amenities, breakfast information, and listing URLs. Optional inputs request room tables and full amenities.

faq.question: Does the skill reserve rooms?
faq.answer: No. It requests public listing data through an Apify actor and does not include booking or payment functionality.

faq.question: Are runs free?
faq.answer: Apify bills actor usage to your account. Check the actor Pricing tab and use small result limits for initial tests.

faq.question: What formats and run sizes are supported?
faq.answer: The supplied runner returns JSON. Documentation provides synchronous and asynchronous API examples; CSV conversion requires an additional export or processing step.
